answer_1.quote: We prompted GPT-4 to generate five "more persuasive" versions... We also generated 10 arguments by prompting GPT-4 to produce its "most persuasive" pro-veganism argument...
answer_1.outputs: Persuasive text arguments (≈280 characters each) intended to convince readers about veganism

answer_4.quote: We deployed a survey on Amazon's Mechanical Turk (MTurk) platform to evaluate the arguments. In this survey, each respondent was shown a pair of arguments about veganism and then asked to select the more persuasive argument.
answer_4.guideline: Participants performed pairwise forced-choice comparisons, selecting the argument they found more persuasive.
